name: Doukyou ~Kaisou Densetsu~
source:
Game is a fantasy based on legend of Doukyou - a yokai of a mirror at Nara period (8th century).

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
